name: In5D PollCraft – Polls, Quizzes & Checklists
author: In5D

sections.description:
In5D PollCraft adds polls and scored checklists to any post, page or widget with a simple shortcode. It’s built for the Classic Editor and works with any theme.

Poll responses are stored as aggregated vote totals rather than individual voting histories, and PollCraft never connects to any outside service. See the FAQ for the short-term data it uses to prevent duplicate voting.

Polls

  • Single-choice polls with live vote percentages
  • Multiple-choice polls (“select all that apply”) with participant counts
  • Exclusive answers like “None of the above” that can’t be combined with other choices
  • An optional image for each answer, plus a main poll image
  • Your own accent color to match your site

Scored checklists

  • Visitors tick the experiences that apply to them and get a score
  • Show a different result for each score range, like “0-3 | The Curious Observer”
  • Scoring happens in the visitor’s browser and nothing is sent or stored

Control and results

  • Start and end dates, so polls open and close on their own
  • Choose when results appear: after voting, always, only after the poll closes, or never
  • A Results & Analytics box on every poll with totals and percentages
  • Duplicate any poll with one click
  • One vote per browser, with a temporary server-side check that discourages repeat voting

Shortcodes

Every poll shows its shortcode in the editor and in the poll list:

[pollcraft id="123"]

The older [in5d_poll id="123"] shortcode works too.

PollCraft Pro and Business

The free plugin is complete on its own. If you need more, PollCraft Pro and Business are available from In5D:

  • Multi-question surveys with single and multiple answers per question
  • CSV export of your results
  • White-label footer with your own text, link and logo (Business)
  • Direct support

Everything you build with the free plugin carries over unchanged.

Privacy

In5D PollCraft doesn’t connect to any outside server, load outside scripts or fonts, or track visitors across sites.

To discourage repeat voting, it sets a cookie in the visitor’s browser and keeps a temporary record for 30 days whose name is a one-way hash of the visitor’s IP address, browser and a site-specific secret. The IP address itself is never stored, and nothing is shown, exported or sent anywhere. Because the hash comes from the IP address, it may count as personal data under laws such as the GDPR, so please mention it in your privacy policy. Checklist answers never leave the visitor’s browser.

Source code

Every file in this plugin is the original, human-readable source. There’s no minified, compiled or generated code and no build step is needed to read or change it.
sections.installation:
1. In your WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins > Add New Plugin and search for “In5D PollCraft”.
  2. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  3. Go to PollCraft > Add Poll or Quiz.
  4. Choose a format, enter your question and add your answers.
  5. Click Publish and copy the shortcode into any post, page or text widget.
sections.faq:
Does it work with the block editor?

Yes. Paste the shortcode into a Shortcode block. The poll builder itself uses the classic post screen, so it works the same everywhere.

Can visitors vote more than once?

PollCraft allows one vote per browser and adds a temporary server-side check to discourage repeat voting. No poll plugin can fully stop a determined person using several devices, so don’t use it for anything that needs verified voting.

What visitor data does PollCraft store?

PollCraft stores poll responses as aggregated vote totals rather than individual voting histories. To help prevent duplicate voting, it uses a browser cookie and retains a temporary, one-way hashed identifier derived from the visitor’s IP address, browser information, and a site-specific secret for 30 days. The raw IP address is not stored in this record, and voting data is processed on your website rather than sent to an external PollCraft service.

Will my polls keep working if I upgrade or switch back?

Yes. The free plugin, PollCraft Pro and the older In5D Polls & Quizzes plugin all share the same poll data, so you can move between them without losing anything.

I have surveys made with In5D PollCraft Pro. What happens if I go back to the free plugin?

They keep displaying and collecting responses. You can still change their intro, colors, results visibility and schedule. Changing a survey’s questions needs In5D PollCraft Pro.

Why is the free plugin “standing by”?

PollCraft Pro already includes everything in the free plugin, so the free plugin steps aside while Pro is active. You can safely deactivate it.

Does it slow down my site?

PollCraft only loads its small script and stylesheet on pages that show a poll.
